title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The Urban Green Graduation programme will work in Dhaka and Chattogram, Bangladesh. It aims to contribute to Concern Bangladesh’s Green Graduation thematic programme, and the goal of the grant is to ensure households can sustainably meet their basic needs and have improved coping strategies through strengthened livelihoods which place value on the natural environment. The programme will support over 69,870 urban extreme poor people living on pavements or informal settlements including female-headed households and households with disabled members. This will be done through supporting households with start-up capital or asset tranfers, supporting households to meet their basic needs, households engaged with micro-enterprises and improved access to affordable, accessible and appropriate financial services and increased savings.OBJECTIVES: Increased financial securityOUTCOMES: Households can sustainably meet their basic needs and have improved coping strategies through strengthened livelihoods which place value on the natural environment
